amendment: Any change to any sealed file produces a new contract_version, a new bundle digest, and a new two-commit freeze. Never an in-place edit under the same advertised digest.
digest_covers: handoff/BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json, which itself carries sorted path + SHA-256 for handoff/contract.json, handoff/CHATGPT_BRIEF.md, handoff/conform.py, all four handoff schemas, all 26 acceptance vectors, and the three pre-existing canonical schemas the bundle depends on.
why_two_commits: A file cannot contain the SHA of the commit that contains it. Commit A freezes the bundle and its manifest; this file, in commit B, records commit A's SHA and the recomputed manifest digest. Conformance verifies both halves and confirms commit A is an ancestor of HEAD.
